mapper.select: SELECT bd.*, -- 计算剩余可执行金额：预算总额 - 申请金额 - (执行金额 - 来自引用申请单的报账单的执行金额) COALESCE(( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(b.budget_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bdr.detail_type = 'APPLY' THEN bdr.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bdr.detail_type = 'PAYOUT' AND (p.source_apply_no IS NULL OR p.source_apply_no = '') THEN bdr.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM budget b LEFT JOIN budget_detail bdr ON b.subject_id = bdr.subject_id AND b.item_id = bdr.item_id LEFT JOIN ctrl_payout p ON p.payout_billcode = bdr.business_no WHERE b.subject_id = bd.subject_id AND b.item_id = bd.item_id AND (b.budget_year = bd.budget_year OR bd.budget_year IS NULL OR b.budget_year IS NULL) GROUP BY b.subject_id, b.item_id ), 0) as remaining_amount FROM budget_detail bd WHERE bd.business_no = #{businessNo} AND bd.amount > 0

SELECT DISTINCT business_no, business_id, amount, create_time FROM budget_detail WHERE subject_code = #{subjectCode} AND item_code = #{itemCode} AND detail_type = 'APPLY' AND amount > 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budget_detail ( budget_year, subject_id, subject_code, subject_name, item_id, item_code, item_name, amount, detail_type, business_id, business_no, dept_id, dept_code, dept_name, emp_id, emp_code, emp_name, remark, create_user ) VALUES ( #{budgetYear}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectCode}, #{subjectName}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{amount}, #{detailType}, #{businessId}, #{businessNo}, #{deptId}, #{deptCode}, #{deptName}, #{empId}, #{empCode}, #{empName}, #{remark}, #{createUser} )
